# Brian Harward, PhD

> Organizational psychologist (PhD) and research scientist in San Antonio,
> Texas. Two practices: advisory for boards and executives navigating
> political polarization, and applied measurement work in psychometrics,
> people analytics, and organizational research.

## Depolarization and stakeholder advisory

Delivered jointly with Morgan Hamel of MH Partners Inc., who is a recognized
expert and speaker on political polarization. Every engagement involves both
of them.

For: corporate boards and executive teams first, and also universities,
nonprofits, government agencies, faith organizations, and professional
associations.

Typical problems: a board split over whether to issue a public statement;
employee mobilization over a political issue; activist or customer pressure
after a decision that was never intended as political; teams that can no
longer talk to each other; managers with no framework for handling political
conflict at work.

Services: board and C-suite advisory, crisis and reputation response,
stakeholder and political dynamics mapping, internal culture and speech
norms, management training, leadership coaching, and custom organizational
research.

Not partisan. The work treats polarization as an organizational and
stakeholder dynamic, using organizational psychology, behavioral science, and
applied ethics.

Engagements run from a single board briefing or workshop through multi-month
advisory relationships, scoped after a discovery conversation. There is no
charge for that conversation and no published price list.

## People analytics and psychometrics

Survey science and employee listening, assessment development and validation,
item response theory, factor analysis, reliability and validity evidence, DIF
and measurement invariance, adverse impact and fairness analysis against EEOC
and UGESP expectations.

Areas measured: emotional intelligence, cognitive abilities, job skills,
personality and work styles, individual strengths.

## Background

PhD in Organizational Psychology, Walden University. Research Scientist at
Ethical Systems, the research nonprofit at NYU Stern School of Business, for
five years as its sole research function. Former Director of Research at San
Diego University for Integrative Studies. Chief Scientific Officer at SciRec.
Distinguished Faculty Award for teaching statistics. Recommendations from
Jonathan Haidt and Alison Taylor are on the site and on LinkedIn.

## Employment

Also open to full-time and contract roles in research science, psychometrics,
and people analytics, remote in the United States. See
